rootCauses: Immediately after src/load selection, Chromium can report NETWORK_NO_SOURCE before its next native task. Capturing that transient state as an exhausted source incorrectly spends the only preparation reload. Yield one task before that classification; a persistently exhausted selection retains the previous cap.

A native paused seek can remain HAVE_METADATA/seeking at prime .05 despite buffered coverage and ongoing tiny transfer progress. Those progress events previously kept resetting transfer inactivity without producing a frame. Observe the covered, physically unchanged seek independently; use only the existing retry after the existing response grace.

A settled radial intro already skipped drawing, but still read the viewport on every scroll/media wake. Skip only that redundant terminal measurement; surface handoff and reversed middle-pose measurement remain active.
